section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant sample for a study conducted with elementary school students. The initial sample of 352 participants was reduced to 347 (171 male, 176 female) after excluding those with intellectual prejudice or comprehension/language difficulties. Participants were drawn from two state schools and three private schools located in small to medium-sized cities, and the sample size was calculated using a 10:1 ratio of participants to test items.
